prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions consistently overstated gains overall, though several unexpected winning updates performed better than predicted.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, adoption wait_info, choose_path hint, choose_path new_flow, choose_path redesign, finish copy, finish notification, home hint, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout, sign_in new_flow, and sign_in wait_info because each has only 1 test.
Interactive finish flows (finish new_flow) remained effective, winning in 4 of 7 tests (+9.4%, +5.6%, +4.3%, and +4.4%).
Home wait_info changes were helpful in 2 of 8 tests (+4.2% and +4.0%), while the remaining 6 showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign consistently hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
No clear effect was seen across tests for adoption copy, choose_path layout, choose_path reorder, finish new_screen, home notification, and sign_in hint.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, copy] Persistent Account Pet Security Sign-In Value Headline: Replaces sign-in headline and body to highlight that signing in ensures pets are permanently saved and never lost. (why: The largest support theme (8 emails) involved users missing or resetting pets after re-signing in. Explicit persistence messaging prevents account drop-off.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Rendering Visual Readiness & Status Monitor: Adds visual rendering status indicators and desktop readiness tips on the waiting screen during pet generation. (why: The waiting stage has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s. Providing explicit rendering progress details reduces user uncertainty during long loads.)
2: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Official Stamp Verification Hint: Displays an official certificate verification status hint clarifying photo quality processing on the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption stage is the biggest bottleneck with only 67.2% conversion, and 3 support emails reported custom pet photo rendering failures.)
3: [sign_in, layout] Split Layout Account Sign-In and Cloud Backup Screen: Changes the sign-in screen to a split layout emphasizing data backup benefits alongside authentication options. (why: Addresses sign-in funnel drop-off (19.6%) and user concerns regarding lost pets by clearly presenting account continuity perks.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Launch Ready Sound Signal & Notification Toggle: Enables sound alert and desktop notification toggles on the waiting screen while background generation finishes. (why: Wait times average over 38 minutes (mean 2336s). Allowing desktop notifications ensures users know when generation finishes without abandoning the app.)
